"""Exact installed-distribution native QA. Evidence only; no source/release mutation."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import venv
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


def sha(path):
    digest=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda:handle.read(65536),b""):digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def safe(path):
    result=Path(path).expanduser().absolute()
    for part in (result,*result.parents):
        try:info=part.lstat()
        except FileNotFoundError:continue
        if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) or getattr(info,"st_file_attributes",0)&0x400:
            raise ValueError("Routing paths must not traverse links/reparse points")
    return result.resolve()


def tests(path):
    cases=ET.parse(path).getroot().findall(".//testcase")
    assert cases and not any(c.find("failure") is not None or c.find("error") is not None for c in cases)
    skipped=[c for c in cases if c.find("skipped") is not None]
    return {"tests":len(cases),"passed":len(cases)-len(skipped),"skipped":len(skipped),"skipped_names":[c.attrib["name"] for c in skipped]}


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    for name in ("source","artifacts","routing","output"):parser.add_argument("--"+name,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    source,artifacts,routing,output=map(safe,(args.source,args.artifacts,args.routing,args.output))
    assert source.is_dir() and artifacts.is_dir() and routing.is_file()
    assert not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink()
    for existing in (source,artifacts,routing.parent):
        assert output!=existing and output not in existing.parents and existing not in output.parents,"Output must be new and disjoint"
    runner_path=Path(__file__).resolve();runner_initial=runner_path.read_bytes()
    raw=routing.read_bytes();config=json.loads(raw)
    assert config["slug"]=="project-continuity-kit" and config["module"]=="project_continuity_kit" and config["version"]=="1.4.1"
    assert platform.system() in {"Windows","Linux"} and sys.version_info>=(3,10)
    for name in config["source_files"]:
        relative=Path(name)
        assert not relative.is_absolute() and all(part not in {".",".."} for part in relative.parts)
    fingerprint=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(config["source_files"],sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()
    assert fingerprint==config["source_files_sha256"]
    def unchanged():
        assert routing.read_bytes()==raw and runner_path.read_bytes()==runner_initial
        for name,digest in config["source_files"].items():assert sha(safe(source/name))==digest,name
        for name,digest in config["tag_artifact_hashes"].items():assert sha(safe(artifacts/name))==digest,name
    unchanged()
    assert set(config["tag_artifact_hashes"])=={"project_continuity_kit-1.4.1-py3-none-any.whl","project_continuity_kit-1.4.1.tar.gz","SHA256SUMS"}
    sums=[line.split() for line in (artifacts/"SHA256SUMS").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    assert len(sums)==2 and {line[1].lstrip("*") for line in sums}==set(config["tag_artifact_hashes"])-{"SHA256SUMS"}
    assert all(config["tag_artifact_hashes"][name.lstrip("*")]==digest for digest,name in sums)
    output.mkdir()
    env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR="1",PYTHONPATH="")
    for key in ("PYTEST_ADDOPTS","PYTEST_PLUGINS","COVERAGE_RCFILE"):env.pop(key,None)
    temp=output/"temp";temp.mkdir();env.update(TMPDIR=str(temp),TMP=str(temp),TEMP=str(temp))
    record={"slug":config["slug"],"version":config["version"],"commit":config["commit"],"tag_object":config["tag_object"],"tag_run":config["tag_run"],"routing_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"runner_sha256":sha(Path(__file__).resolve()),"source_files_sha256":fingerprint,"platform":platform.platform(),"system":platform.system(),"python":sys.version,"artifacts":[]}
    contract=config["native_contract"]["windows" if platform.system()=="Windows" else "linux"]
    def run(cmd,cwd,log):
        result=subprocess.run([str(x) for x in cmd],cwd=cwd,env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=False)
        with log.open("x",encoding="utf-8") as handle:handle.write(result.stdout)
        if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(f"Command failed ({result.returncode}); see {log}")
        return result.stdout
    for index,name in enumerate(sorted(set(config["tag_artifact_hashes"])-{"SHA256SUMS"})):
        unchanged();root=output/f"artifact-{index}";root.mkdir();work=root/"work";work.mkdir();environment=root/"venv";venv.EnvBuilder(with_pip=True).create(environment)
        python=environment/("Scripts/python.exe" if os.name=="nt" else "bin/python")
        run([python,"-B","-m","pip","install",str(artifacts/name),"pytest>=8,<10","pytest-cov>=6,<8"],work,root/"install.log")
        probe="import project_continuity_kit,sys;from pathlib import Path;assert 'site-packages' in project_continuity_kit.__file__;assert project_continuity_kit.__version__=='1.4.1'; print(project_continuity_kit.__file__); docs=Path(sys.prefix)/'share/doc/project-continuity-kit';source=Path(sys.argv[1]);[(lambda n:None if (docs/n).read_bytes()==(source/n).read_bytes() else (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError(n)))(n) for n in ['README.md','DEVELOPMENT.md','TESTING.md','CHANGELOG.md','LICENSE','examples/sample.json','examples/README.md']]"
        run([python,"-I","-B","-c",probe,source],work,root/"import-docs.log")
        env["COVERAGE_FILE"]=str(root/".coverage")
        full=root/"full.xml";focused=root/"native.xml"
        base=[python,"-I","-B","-m","pytest","-c",str(source/"pyproject.toml"),"-o","cache_dir="+str(root/"pytest-cache")]
        log=run(base+[str(source/"tests"),"--basetemp",str(root/"full-tmp"),"--junitxml",str(full)],work,root/"full.log")
        assert "Required test coverage of 90% reached" in log
        summary=tests(full)
        assert all(summary[key]==contract["full_"+key] for key in ("tests","passed","skipped"))
        if platform.system()=="Windows":assert summary["skipped_names"]==contract["allowed_skip_names"]
        run(base+[str(source/"tests/test_native_paths.py"),"-o","addopts=","--basetemp",str(root/"native-tmp"),"--junitxml",str(focused)],work,root/"native.log")
        native=tests(focused);assert all(native[key]==contract["focused_"+key] for key in ("tests","passed","skipped"))
        if platform.system()=="Windows":assert native["skipped"]==0
        else:assert all(name.startswith("test_windows_") for name in native["skipped_names"])
        console=environment/("Scripts/continuity-kit.exe" if os.name=="nt" else "bin/continuity-kit")
        fixture=work/"fixture";fixture.mkdir();readme=fixture/"README.md";readme.write_bytes(b"Immutable initial observation\n")
        excluded=fixture/".env";excluded.write_bytes(b"SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE=one\n")
        spec=work/"spec.json";spec.write_text(json.dumps({"root":str(fixture)}),encoding="utf-8")
        bundle=work/"bundle.zip"
        source_before={"README.md":sha(readme),".env":sha(excluded)}
        generated=json.loads(run([console,spec,"--bundle",bundle,"--format","json"],work,root/"console-generate.log"))
        assert bundle.is_file() and generated["scan_complete"] is True
        bundle_initial=sha(bundle)
        verified=json.loads(run([console,"--verify-bundle",bundle,"--root",fixture],work,root/"console-match.log"))
        assert verified["matches"] is True and verified["scan_complete"] is True
        assert source_before=={"README.md":sha(readme),".env":sha(excluded)}
        excluded.write_bytes(b"SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE=two\n")
        matched=json.loads(run([console,"--verify-bundle",bundle,"--root",fixture],work,root/"console-excluded.log"))
        assert matched["matches"] is True
        readme.write_bytes(b"Changed included evidence\n")
        drift=json.loads(run([console,"--verify-bundle",bundle,"--root",fixture],work,root/"console-drift.log"))
        assert drift["matches"] is False and drift["changes"]["changed"]
        refused=subprocess.run([str(console),str(spec),"--bundle",str(bundle)],cwd=work,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
        with (root/"console-refusal.log").open("x",encoding="utf-8") as handle:handle.write(refused.stdout+refused.stderr)
        assert refused.returncode==2 and sha(bundle)==bundle_initial
        unchanged();record["artifacts"].append({"name":name,"sha256":config["tag_artifact_hashes"][name],"full":summary,"native":native,"site_packages_import_verified":True,"installed_docs_verified":True,"coverage_gate":90,"passed":True})
    unchanged();record["passed"]=True;record["inputs_unchanged"]=True
    result=output/"RESULT.json"
    with result.open("x",encoding="utf-8") as handle:json.dump(record,handle,indent=2);handle.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"result":str(result),"sha256":sha(result),"passed":True}))


if __name__=="__main__":main()
